name: Birmingham City Schools
calendarType: District event calendar with intersessions, e-Learning days and reporting-period totals
seoDescription: Browse Birmingham City Schools calendars by school year, with reviewed intersessions, e-Learning days, reporting periods, official PDFs and ICS downloads.
districtFact: BCS annual event calendars publish separate student and teacher totals, four reporting periods, intersessions and e-Learning/Parent Conference Days. The district calendar page also provides translated and assessment-calendar resources.
calendarNotes: Use the selected BCS school-year calendar for districtwide attendance dates. e-Learning/Parent Conference Days remain instructional dates rather than school closures. The assessment calendar has a separate testing scope, and translated calendars are companion resources. School events and later revisions should be confirmed with BCS or the assigned school. A MySchoolDates ICS file is a one-time import and does not update automatically.
